summary: Park car park beside a hall and open lawn; homes across the road.
reasons: Northern bays back onto open park lawn
Nearest home 40 m+ from north edge

best_section.where: Northern row of bays, backing onto the park lawn

drivers.seclusion: North edge faces open parkland with trees. Hall to the east is non-residential. Nearest dwellings (25 m and more) are across the road to the south-west.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with painted bays, entering directly from the road. Several cars parked, room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Collector road along the south edge; moderate traffic, set back from the north bays.
drivers.convention: Mapped public car park serving the park and hall; cars park there.

flags: Steep: about 4% on the north edge
Low-lying: about 5 to 8 m elevation, waterway 107 m away
Bus zone sign on the road outside
Hall and school activity by day
sun_shade: Trees shade the north-east and west sides; bays largely open to the midday sun.
